sc_cat_item_producer.description:
Raising an employee issue (grievance)
involves formally documenting and reporting concerns about unfair treatment, policy breaches, or safety issues, typically after informal resolution attempts have failed. A clear, written description should include specific details like dates, names, witnesses, and the desired resolution to ensure HR can investigate and address the matter effectively.
sc_cat_item_producer.name: Raise Employee Issue
